title: Because That Day, They Showed Me a Dream

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—And here it is, the day has finally come!
Which Umamusume will seize glory and show us a brand-new dream!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is about to begin—!!
(WAAAAAAHHHHHH—!!)

The Japanese Derby... It is a truly special race for
Umamusume, Trainers, and fans alike.

Run over 2,400 meters on turf, it is one leg of the
Twinkle Series “Classic Triple Crown”—

And it is said that “becoming the Trainer of a Derby
Umamusume is harder than becoming Prime Minister.”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I don't really know what a “prime minister” is, but
it sounds like someone super duper important, right?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And because they say the Derby is even harder to achieve
than becoming someone that amazing—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The girl who wins it can give everyone watching
so much emotion, hope, and dreams!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm here!!
It's the Derby! There's no way I'd miss it—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd run into my fellow ant-watcher in a place
like this, though! I'm so haaaapppppy—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Whoa!! The race is about to start...!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: Carrying the dreams of everyone involved in the race, now—

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text: They're off to an even start!!
(WAAAAAAAAHHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The field rounds the 4th corner!
Here comes the fateful home stretch!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOHHHHH—!!
Everyone, do your best, everyoooone—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at number 5's late kick!!
Ah, but wait, number 11 is closing in fast too...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, the race favorite is coming all the way from the outside?!
Can she pull it off?! Is she gonna win it?!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
—GOOOOOAAAAAL!!
The pinnacle of Umamusume has just been decided—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
She did ittttt—!!
Incredible... wow... everyone... tried so... hard...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
W-WAAAAAAHHHHHH—!!!!
I'M ZO MOOOOVEEDDD—!!!!

It took a while... actually, quite a long while
for an overjoyed Winning Ticket to stop crying.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... *snort*...
That really was an amazing race, wasn't it—?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Man, the Derby really is the best...!
Uuuuugh, I wanna run there so baaaadly too—!!
choice_data_list: You really do care deeply about the Derby.
You really have strong feelings for the Derby, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Well, yeah, of course I do!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I got to play all kinds of sports since I was little,
y'know? But discovering races was something truly special!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
At first, I only watched them on TV, but
even so, I could feel all the fiery passion from the crowd!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Seeing all those girls giving it their absolute best, I realized
how much courage and energy they gave to everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And that... was just so amazing, that...
it always, always makes me cry... *sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...*gasp*! I'm fine!!
Ehehe, I just got carried away remembering how that felt!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because of that, races were always a place I looked up
to from the start, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
One day, I went to watch one with my family!!
—The Japanese Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The intensity and heat were just craaaazy! Even though I was little
and didn't know anything about racing, I understood right away!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That this place was somewhere truly “special”!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And then, the fans around me told me!
“The Derby is packed full of dreams.”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“A ‘Derby Umamusume’ is someone
who makes everyone's dreams come true!”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm gonna win the Derby!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Just like those girls I saw on TV back then!! Just like the ones
I saw from the stands that day!! Just like the ones running here today!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely become a “Derby Umamusume”
who can give dreams to everyone, toooooo—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WHAAAAT?!?!?!?!?
W-W-W-W-Wondefuuul?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
You think so? Ehehe... ehehehehe~!
...Eep, I feel all ticklish inside! It's making me squirm...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, though!!
I'm gonna do my best to reach my dream!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
...Though, before that, I gotta find a Trainer to take charge
of me so I can debut... but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WHAAAAAAAATTTTTT?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
H-H-Hold on, ant-watcher friend!!
That!! That lapel pin!! Don't tell me...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're a Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I JUST!! NOTICED IT NOOOOWWW!!!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And so...!!
Please become my Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Pleeease, pleeease, pleeeaaase...! I waaaant to become
a “Derby Umamusume” more than anything in the world!

Her sheer sincerity had come through loud and clear
throughout everything we'd talked about so far...

Knowing how deeply she feels about this... as a Trainer,
there's no way I could turn her down!
choice_data_list: Alright, let's aim for the Derby together!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: For real?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uuuuuughhhhh~~~~~... YEEEEEEE...
EEEEEEEESSSSSSS—!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer, thank youuu!!
Really... seriously... *sniff*...!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank you soooo, sooo muuuuch—!
WAAAAAAHHHHHH—!!
